title: lippia echinus
intro: Lippia echinus, commonly known as wild marjoram, is a plant species belonging to the Verbenaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lippia echinus include its antimicrobial, antiviral, and antioxidant activities, making it useful in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory effects.
